name: skip-link
title: Skip Link
description: A link to the main content that stays hidden until it takes keyboard focus, then floats at the top start of the viewport above everything else.
docs: Render it first in `<body>`: `<SkipLink>Skip to content</SkipLink>`. The text is required (write it in the page's language); `href` defaults to `#main`, which `PageLayout as="main"` provides. See the Sidebar docs for where it goes in an app shell.
